name: Delska EU North Riga LV DC3

name: Delska EU North Riga LV DC1

name: Delska EU North Riga LV DC2

name: Tet Riga data centres (DC6 Kleistu iela 5 and Dattum/Brivibas/Perses/Atlasa sites)
notes: Tet operates multiple Riga facilities: DC6 at Kleistu iela 5 (~0.3 MW, opened 2021, at the time the only Uptime Institute Tier III certified DC in Latvia) plus Dattum (1.4 MW), Brivibas (0.7 MW), Kleistu (1.2 MW), Perses (0.7 MW), Atlasa (~40 cabinets); capacity figures per LV methodology.

name: LVRTC Riga data centres / Baltic Data Hub (Tier II + Tier III, Zaķusala TV Tower)
developer: LVRTC (Latvijas Valsts radio un televīzijas centrs)
notes: LVRTC Tier II/Tier III colocation in Riga (HQ Zemitana iela 9 k-3; DC inside Zaķusala TV Tower, Zakusalas krastmala 1); PUE 1.4, 99.98% availability, 40+ telecom operators; nationwide regional colocation every 100 km (Reģionu datu centri page updated 16.12.2024).

name: CloudHosting Tier 3+ data centre
notes: Small commercial colocation/hosting DC at Bērzaunes iela 1, Riga; operator-claimed Tier 3+; minor facility.

name: VERnet DC
notes: Commercial colocation DC in Riga city centre, Tier II-III per operator page; minor facility.

name: Northern Energy Liepaja data centre (CIS Liepaja, Liepaja SEZ)
developer: Northern Europe Energy Group (AS) / SIA CIS Liepaja
notes: Planned AI-ready data centre campus in Liepaja Special Economic Zone (per LV methodology: 120 MW, 110/33 kV, target ~2029); official Northern Energy pages currently frame CIS Liepaja as EUR 550M green hydrogen / Power-to-X complex (Jaunā ostmala 1) with hydrogen supply to NorSAF; no BIS/municipal construction or commissioning confirmation found - status planned, capacity from methodology seed only.
